There are no network operations, no execution of external scripts, no obfuscated code, and no system modifications outside the build directory. The changes are focused solely on enabling shared library support for the libXNVCtrl component, which can be useful for other applications linking against it.

All commands used (`$(CC)`, `-shared`, `-Wl,-soname`, `ln -s`) are standard in Make-based builds. The patch does not introduce any suspicious or potentially malicious behavior. It enhances the build system in a way consistent with upstream packaging needs.
